Given the high phylogenetic signal derived from Bayesian models, we attempt to predict species sensitivity using the `Rphylopars` package.
Using the complete species sensitivity dataset generated by the machine learning model, we randomly mask 40% of species per chemical to be treated as missing and predict their sensitivity based on the phylogeny and the remaining 60% of species with known sensitivity.


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())   
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(ape)
library(Rphylopars)
library(patchwork)
library(phytools)
set.seed(1010)
```

# 1. Load dataset 
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS.rds"))

phylo_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/phylo_tree.rds"))

observed_sensi <- readRDS(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity.rds"))
```

```{r}
chem_groups <- c("Arthropod_control", "Auxiliary_other",
                 "Fungal_control", "Vertebrate_control",
                 "Plant_control", "Mixed_multitarget")

mask_fracs <- c(0.70) 

out_dir <- here("plots/phylopars_prediction")
fits_dir <- here("model_output/phylopars_fits")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fits_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 2. fit phylopars
Functions:
```{r}
# Build species x CAS wide and mask a fraction per CAS

build_and_mask_wide <- function(dat, chemgroup, mask_frac) {
  wide <- dat %>%
    filter(duration == "24") %>%
    filter(chem_group == chemgroup) %>%
    group_by(latin, CAS) %>%
    summarise(val = mean(log_sensi, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CAS, values_from = val) %>%
    rename(species = latin) %>%
    distinct()
  
  if (nrow(wide) == 0) return(NULL)
  rownames(wide) <- wide$species
  
  trait_mv  <- wide
  cas_cols  <- setdiff(names(trait_mv), "species")
  
  masked_pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(cas_cols, function(cn) {
    sp_nonmiss <- trait_mv$species[!is.na(trait_mv[[cn]])]
    n_mask <- max(1, floor(mask_frac * length(sp_nonmiss)))
    tibble(species = sample(sp_nonmiss, n_mask), CAS = cn)})
  
  if (nrow(masked_pairs) > 0) {
    idx <- match(masked_pairs$species, trait_mv$species)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(masked_pairs))) {
      trait_mv[idx[j], masked_pairs$CAS[j]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  list(wide_full = wide, trait_mv = trait_mv, masked_pairs = masked_pairs)
}


# Fit phylopars (fast defaults for wide CAS matrices)
fit_phylopars_fast <- function(trait_mv, tree) {
  phylopars(
    trait_data       = trait_mv,
    tree             = tree,
    model            = "lambda",
    pheno_error      = FALSE,
    phylo_correlated = FALSE,
    pheno_correlated = FALSE
    )
}


# Build plotting df and make a panel (no CAS colors/legend)
make_plot_from_fit <- function(fit, wide_full, masked_pairs, observed_sensi,
                               title_prefix, mask_frac) {
  lambda_hat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$model$lambda))
  lambda_lab <- if (is.finite(lambda_hat)) paste0(" (Pagel's \u03BB = ",
                                          round(lambda_hat, 3), ")") else ""
  tip_order    <- fit$tree$tip.label
  tip_pred_mat <- as.data.frame(fit$anc_recon[tip_order, , drop = FALSE]) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("species")
  
  pred_long <- tip_pred_mat %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "CAS", values_to = "pred")
  
  truth_long <- wide_full %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "CAS", values_to = "truth")
  
  eval_df <- pred_long %>%
    dplyr::left_join(truth_long, by = c("species", "CAS"))
  
  observed_long <- observed_sensi %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      species  = as.character(latin),
      CAS      = as.character(CAS_norm),
      observed = as.numeric(conc)
      ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(species), !is.na(CAS), !is.na(observed)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  df_plot <- eval_df %>%
    left_join(masked_pairs %>% mutate(masked = TRUE), by = c("species","CAS")) %>%
    left_join(observed_long, by = c("species","CAS"))
  
  fs <- 22
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = truth, y = pred)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.6) +
    geom_point(
      data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, !is.na(observed)),
      aes(x = observed, y = pred),
      size = 2.0, alpha = 0.6, color = "blue", shape = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    #coord_equal() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(title_prefix),
      x = "Sensitivity (log10)",
      y = "Phylo-predicted sensitivity (log10)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = fs) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position  = "none")
}

```

# 3. Fit & save per chemical group
```{r}
fit_and_save_all <- function(mask_frac) {
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (g in chem_groups) {
    message("Fitting: ", g, " | mask ", mask_frac)
    wm <- build_and_mask_wide(spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS, g, mask_frac)
    
    fit <- fit_phylopars_fast(wm$trait_mv, phylo_tree)
    res <- list(
      chem_group   = g,
      mask_frac    = mask_frac,
      fit          = fit,
      wide_full    = wm$wide_full,
      trait_mv     = wm$trait_mv,
      masked_pairs = wm$masked_pairs,
      lambda       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fit$model$lambda)))
    
    all_results[[g]] <- res
    saveRDS(res, file = file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fit_", g, "_mask",
                              round(mask_frac * 100), ".rds")))
    }
  
  saveRDS(all_results, file = file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fits_all_mask",
                              round(mask_frac * 100), ".rds")))
  invisible(all_results)
}

# run for each mask fraction
all_results_list <- lapply(mask_fracs, fit_and_save_all)
names(all_results_list) <- paste0("mask", round(mask_fracs * 100))

```


# 4. Plot each group
```{r}
read_results <- function(mask_frac) {
  tag  <- paste0("mask", round(mask_frac*100))
  comb <- file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fits_all_", tag, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(comb)) return(readRDS(comb))

  # fallback: per-group files
  res <- setNames(vector("list", length(chem_groups)), chem_groups)
  for (g in chem_groups) {
    fp <- file.path(fits_dir, paste0("phylopars_fit_", g, "_", tag, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(fp)) res[[g]] <- readRDS(fp)
  }
  res <- res[!vapply(res, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (!length(res)) stop("No saved results found for ", tag,
                         ". Run the fitting step first.")
  res
}

# load results for each mask fraction
all_results_list <- lapply(mask_fracs, read_results)
names(all_results_list) <- paste0("mask", round(mask_fracs*100))  # <-- add names

plot_each_group <- function(all_results, mask_frac) {
  plots <- vector("list", length(all_results))
  names(plots) <- names(all_results)

  for (g in names(all_results)) {
    res <- all_results[[g]]
    p <- make_plot_from_fit(
      fit            = res$fit,
      wide_full      = res$wide_full,
      masked_pairs   = res$masked_pairs,
      observed_sensi = observed_sensi,
      title_prefix   = g,
      mask_frac      = mask_frac
    )
    plots[[g]] <- p
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(
        "phylo_vs_truth_vs_observed_", g, "_mask", round(mask_frac*100), ".png"
      )),
      plot = p, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300
    ) 
  }
  plots
}

plots_list <- Map(plot_each_group, all_results_list, mask_fracs)
names(plots_list) <- names(all_results_list)  # now valid because we named it above

```

# 5. Combined 2×3 plot
```{r}
for (i in seq_along(mask_fracs)) {
  mf     <- mask_fracs[i]
  plots  <- plots_list[[i]]  # <- THIS is the 'plots' the combined step needs

  # Keep the intended order; drop groups that didn't produce a plot
  avail_groups   <- intersect(chem_groups, names(plots))
  plots_in_order <- lapply(avail_groups, function(g) plots[[g]])

  # Safety: if nothing to plot, skip
  if (length(plots_in_order) == 0) next

  combined <- wrap_plots(plots_in_order, nrow = 2, ncol = 3) &
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(combined)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      out_dir,
      sprintf("phylo_vs_truth_vs_observed_all_6groups_mask%02d.png", round(mf * 100))
    ),
    plot  = combined,
    width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300
  )
}

```
